$comment: P69 review MINOR 7 (D-LK-LIBRARY-FUNCTION-ADDRESS-IS-THE-IMAGE-STUB) — the aarch64 twin of `asm_x86_64_library_function_address_equals_dlsym`: a hand-written unit takes the address of `puts` as `adr x20, puts` (computed from the place, R_AARCH64_ADR_PREL_LO21) and as `.quad puts` (R_AARCH64_ABS64), and both must equal dlsym(dlopen(NULL), "puts") in an ELF executable and a PIE, where the image makes its stub the import's canonical address. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-30 natively on aarch64: gcc 13.3 -no-pie and -pie answer 42 for C's `&puts` and its static initializer on the same canonical-stub rule. Exit 42; 1 the computed address differs from dlsym's, 2 the stored one does, 3 dlopen(NULL) failed. Runs natively on the arm64 leg and under qemu-aarch64 elsewhere. The `release` arm pins that naming the release pipeline does not break an assembly source.
